title: Knightfall
description: Glide through a storm-lit city, thread aerial routes, catch a falling civilian, and land atop the signal tower.

prompt.objective: Build a cinematic rooftop gliding game.

mintAssets.brief: A rigged nocturnal vigilante with gliding animations and a cape.
A rain-soaked skyline with towers, bridges, a ferris wheel, and a blimp.

experience: Launch from a rooftop and follow aerial rings through the city.
Rescue a falling civilian and finish at the illuminated signal tower.
prompt.visualDirection: Midnight blue rooftops, silver rain, gold signals, and comic-book cinematic framing.

thumbnail.alt: A caped vigilante gliding above a storm-lit city skyline.

social.title: Knightfall — Glide Through the Storm
social.description: Thread the skyline, make the rescue, and reach the signal tower before dawn.

image.alt: A caped vigilante gliding above a storm-lit city skyline.
